verdict.rationale: Docs and a hands-on probe confirm `semgrep ci`/`semgrep scan` integrates into CI providers (docs-14, docs-25/28) and exits non-zero on findings (probe-5 shows exit code 1 with JSON findings), plus SARIF export (docs-3/20) and pre-commit hook support (docs-16) for pre-PR gating. Missing for 10: explicit documentation/evidence of diff-aware 'new findings only' baseline behavior on PRs, and independent (non-vendor) confirmation of CI exit-code gating in real pipelines.
